summary: ```markdown # Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025.0 - [Beta] Hair Effects Displayed in 3D Window Welcome to the new feature introduction video of Marvelous Designer 2025. In this version, several exciting features related to hair effects have been introduced. ## New Fabric Material Type for Hair In the 2025 version, the fabric material type has been newly added to hair and hairstyles. This fabric material type can be used for clothing, braids, and stickers. You can see the hair and hairstyle effects whether you turn on the high-quality rendering display or not. Additionally, the hair and hairstyle can be used in other 3D software through the USB file format. ### Exporting Hair Data To export the hair and hair data, click on the hair in the USB file settings. ## Various Settings for Hair and Hairstyles Next, let's take a look at the various settings related to hair and hairstyles. ### Material Type Adjustment First, you can change the material type to hair and hairstyle. Then, you can adjust the hair properties on this material at the bottom. There are three options for the shape of the hair: - **Round:** Round with thickness and width. This shape is suitable for checking the overall structure of the hair. - **Flat:** A flat shape with thickness but width. - **Line:** No thickness, no width, curve shape. ### Preview Settings Please note that when you turn on the preview hair effect, the simulation speed may be significantly reduced due to the need to calculate the hair effect in the 3D window. If you need to improve simulation efficiency, you can choose whether to turn on the preview hair effect in the 3D display icon. It is recommended that you only turn on this option when necessary. ### Random Hair Color If you need to check the hair color randomly, you can turn on the random color option. Additionally, when recording or playing animation, it is strongly recommended that you turn off the preview hair effect, as it can affect simulation speed. ## Hair and Hair Settings on Fabric To apply the hair effect, select the fabric type that needs the hair effect in the object window. Then, in the property editor below, change the material type to hair. The hair effect will be displayed in the 3D window, revealing various hair settings in the property editor. ### Hair Material Properties You can set the following properties for hair material: - **Degree of Gray:** Influences the darkness or lightness of the gray added to the hair. A higher value results in darker gray, while a lower value results in lighter gray. - **Degree of Red:** Determines the amount of red in the hair. The higher the value, the more red in the hair, based on the ratio of black to orange. - **Brightness:** Affects the overall brightness of the hair. - **Degree of Smoothness:** Influences the texture of hair reflection. A higher value results in smoother hair reflection. ### Hair Color Settings When you open the hair change color option, a purple menu appears at the bottom. Here, you can set the middle and top colors of the hair. The middle color refers to the hair's midsection, while the top color refers to the hair's top. You can adjust the positions of these colors accordingly. ## Hair Shape Settings In the hair shape settings, you can adjust the following: - **Length:** Controlled by the length of the hair. The higher the value, the longer the hair. - **Thickness:** Controlled by the thickness of each hair strand. A higher value results in thicker hair. - **Inclination:** Controlled by the attitude of the hair. The higher the value, the more pronounced the effect. ### Hair Density and Sections The density affects how thick the hair appears; higher values yield thicker hair, while lower values yield thinner hair. The number of sections corresponds to the number of divisions in a hair strand. ## Basic Sticker for Hair Effects Using black and white basic stickers can demonstrate different length, thickness, and density hair effects on the same piece of hair. - When the base sticker is black, the length, thickness, and density are multiplied by 0. - When the base sticker is white, the length, thickness, and density are multiplied by 1. ## Hair Vinegar Function You can create a realistic hair vinegar effect using the hair vinegar function. In this window, you can adjust hair length distribution and bend direction. ### Length and Bend Distribution In the property setting area, you can adjust the hair length distribution. First, apply a cutout picture to set a base for the hair length picture. The cutout picture will affect the hair length distribution based on brightness or transparency. ## Cutout Effect Settings The intensity of the cutout effect will influence the appearance of thin, separated hair. The random value will affect the distribution of hair, and the higher the random value, the more obvious the distribution effect. ## Gravity and Bending Area Settings ### Gravity Settings Set the gravity of the hair follicles. After configuring the gravity, you need to change at least one axis value to zero to see the gravity effect. ### Bending Area Settings Adjust the radius and amount of the curls on the hair. A higher radius will create bigger curls, making the hair appear fluffier, while a lower value will yield thinner curls. ## Additional Hair Properties - **Length Distribution Irregularity:** Higher values indicate more irregular lengths, while lower values indicate more uniform lengths. - **Thickness Distribution Irregularity:** Affects how irregular the thickness of the hair appears. - **Direction Irregularity:** Higher values lead to more irregular bends in the hair. - **Weight Irregularity:** Higher values indicate more irregular weight distribution. Finally, set the weighted value and the axis to visualize the distribution irregularity of the gravity effect, curly radius, and control over the hair's curly radius. ## Random Seed Distribution You can experiment with different random arrangement effects through seed distribution without changing properties. ```
